spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pixie casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pixie has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Faerie Dust
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}1 Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (pixie's choice) until the start of the pixie's next turn.
